headword: {編入試験|へんにゅうしけん}

definitions.explanation: An entrance examination for students seeking to transfer into a university or school at a year other than the first. In Japan, this typically allows students from junior colleges or technical colleges to enter the third year of a four-year university.

examples.japanese: {編入試験|へんにゅうしけん}を{受|う}ける。
{編入試験|へんにゅうしけん}の{対策|たいさく}を{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I started preparing for the transfer examination.

examples.japanese: {短大|たんだい}を{卒業|そつぎょう}してから、{四年制大学|よねんせいだいがく}の{編入試験|へんにゅうしけん}に{合格|ごうかく}して{三年次|さんねんじ}に{入学|にゅうがく}した。
examples.english: After graduating from junior college, I passed the transfer exam and enrolled as a third-year student at a four-year university.

notes:
Composed of {編入|へんにゅう} (transfer, incorporation) and {試験|しけん} (examination). A specific type of entrance exam for mid-program admission.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {編入試験|へんにゅうしけん}を{受|う}ける: to take a transfer exam
- {編入試験|へんにゅうしけん}に{合格|ごうかく}する: to pass a transfer exam
- {編入試験|へんにゅうしけん}の{過去問|かこもん}: past transfer exam questions
- {三年次|さんねんじ}{編入試験|へんにゅうしけん}: third-year transfer exam

RELATED WORDS:
- {編入生|へんにゅうせい}: transfer student — the student who passes this exam
- {入学試験|にゅうがくしけん}: entrance examination — the standard first-year admission exam
- {推薦入試|すいせんにゅうし}: recommendation-based admission — another alternative admission pathway

USAGE:
The format varies by university but often includes a written exam in the student's field, an English exam, and an interview. Competition can be intense at top universities.
